`rmdir`: remove empty directories.

## Synopsis

<strong>rmdir</strong> <em>dir</em>...

## Description

<strong>rmdir</strong> removes each <em>dir</em> named, which must be empty. A directory that can't be removed is reported on standard error as <strong>rmdir:</strong> <em>dir</em><strong>:</strong> <em>reason</em> and the rest are still tried.

## Exit status

0 if every directory was removed (or none was named), 1 if any could not be.

## Notes

There are no options: no <strong>-p</strong> to remove parent directories too.

## See also

<strong>mkdir</strong>(1), <strong>rm</strong>(1)
